phase3_findings.description: _required_checks() derives the coverage floor from the real .github/workflows/ci.yml; an absent ci.yml returns an empty frozenset making coverage vacuous (fail-open under-gating), and no regression test pins that the repo's real ci.yml still declares the required set. Verified production ci.yml currently parses to both required checks, so not a live defect.

Marker parser reads only the first non-blank line after each prflow:required-check marker; an interposed comment or reorder would silently drop a required check from the set (fail-open). Adjacency contract is unpinned. Current ci.yml satisfies it.
Two new inline comments (ci_record intro 671-676; workpad.py 5411-5415) exceed the project 3-line comment-discipline cap; behavior-inert.

notes: All issue #1898 ACs verified: cloud tier refused, absent/other tier refused, required-check coverage floor refuses uncovered sets naming first missing member, every non-success conclusion refused, direct/loop reach CI path via --ci-record while undischarged-findings and deferral classes still run, required set read from the single declared source ci.yml. vrecord left unassigned only where every read is guarded by ci_record is None. Empty --completion-ci-check yields empty checks list which is refused before any PATCH. Including the lint job in the required set is the intended fix for the PR-1888 tests-green/lint-red bug, not an over-constraint.
